summary: Backend-only verification of RajaOnam 2026 dummy VIP complimentary booking EO-GAASYU. critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1096 lines — recommend splitting into modules (pdf, email, admin, bookings) for maintainability.

WhatsApp caption in send_whatsapp_confirmation still shows 'Complimentary (COMP)' for COMP bookings while the redesigned email and PDF use 'VIP Ticket'. Not in scope of this test request but inconsistent branding — flag for main agent if WhatsApp should also say 'VIP Ticket'.
FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — migrate to lifespan handlers.
booking_email_html derives asset_base via qr_url.split('api/')[0] — fragile if base URL ever contains 'api/' elsewhere; use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / explicit base.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-existing dummy booking EO-GAASYU as instructed (not created, not deleted).
